ValidationRule.description: Duplicating the BH Man Package val rule but with exception for Multi-Client CYP Jobs: https://1218globaluk.eu.teamwork.com/app/tasks/36162794
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(RecordType.DeveloperName <> "Multi_Child_Young_Person_Contract", OR( AND( !ISNULL(TR1__Maximum_Pay_Rate__c), !ISNULL(TR1__Maximum_Bill_Rate__c), TR1__Maximum_Pay_Rate__c > TR1__Maximum_Bill_Rate__c ), AND( !ISNULL(TR1__Maximum_Pay_Rate__c), ISNULL(TR1__Maximum_Bill_Rate__c) ), AND( ISNULL(TR1__Maximum_Pay_Rate__c), !ISNULL(TR1__Maximum_Bill_Rate__c) ) )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Maximum Pay Rate should not be greater then Maximum Bill Rate or any one of the rate should not be blank
